tasks.short: Inspect returned books and compute fines

steps.what: Inspect returned books for condition and due-date status
Compute applicable fines from the stored due date and rate
Review the fine amount against the returned book
Post the accepted fine on the patron record

tasks.design: The assistant inspects the returned book. {DOCS} computes a fine from the stored due date, the return date, and the rate row. The assistant accepts or waives that amount, and only the accepted amount is posted. A missing date or rate stays blank and no fine is posted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant looked up the due date and re-did the arithmetic on each return.
tasks.enabler_now: Due date, return date, and rate are stored fields, so the arithmetic is a subtraction and a table.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing damage, and deciding a waiver, stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant waives a fine when the condition or the story does not match the amount.

ambition.what: An ordinary overdue return shows its fine while the patron is still at the desk.

tasks.altitude: Inspection stays. The assistant decides the fine instead of re-doing the sum.

reach.task: Set the fine rate and the waiver cases
reach.learn: Which damage is a fine and which is a waiver.

evidence.claim: A due date and a rate row can compute a fine. A missing date or rate leaves the amount blank.
A fine is a charge on a named patron. The assistant accepts the amount before it is posted. The design does not decide a waiver.

assumptions: The work starts with a returned book and ends with a condition note and, where the assistant accepts it, a posted fine.
A loan row has item identifier, patron identifier, due date, and return date. The rate row has day band and amount, maintained by a librarian. A missing date or rate is left blank.
The post uses the amount accepted in the review. Inspection time is not reduced by the arithmetic.
unknowns: Which waivers the librarian allows the desk to grant.
research_questions: How many returns had a blank due date, and how many fines did the assistant waive?

already_counted.description: Inspecting returned books for condition is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a rate row after a librarian changes the fine band.

approvals.approved_version: fine amount the assistant accepted for this return

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: due dates are often missing, so the assistant still computes by hand. High: dates and rates are present, and inspection plus the waiver decision remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain item records and file catalog cards

steps.what: File catalog cards according to the system used
Maintain records of items received and stored
Assemble issued and returned counts from stored loan events
Review the issued and returned counts
Write the accepted record of issued and returned items

tasks.design: The assistant files catalog cards by the system in use and maintains the record of items received and stored. {DATA_PLATFORM} totals issued and returned counts from loan events already stored. The assistant reviews those counts, and {DOCS} writes only the accepted record. A missing event date stays out of the total.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant copied issued and returned totals off the day sheet by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Loan events already carry item and date, so the total is a count.
tasks.still_hard: Filing cards, and noticing a receipt the day sheet never had, stay manual.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant holds back a count that does not match the cards just filed.
tasks.altitude: Card filing stays. Issued and returned totals are written only after the assistant accepts them.

reach.task: Choose the catalog system the cards follow
reach.learn: Which heading the system uses when two cards could fit.

evidence.claim: Stored loan events can be counted. A missing date is left out. Filing cards stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a card or a receipt and ends with a filed card and, where accepted, an updated count record.
A loan event has item identifier, issued or returned flag, and date, entered at the desk. A receipt row has item identifier and stored location, entered by the assistant. A blank date is not counted.
The write uses the counts accepted in the review. Time the circulation log already spends storing an event is not the assistant's saving.
unknowns: Whether the library still files physical catalog cards.
research_questions: How often did the assistant reject the count because a receipt was not on the events?

already_counted.description: Filing catalog cards is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a receipt row the assistant added and the count must include.

approvals.approved_version: issued and returned counts the assistant accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: loan events are incomplete, so the assistant still totals by hand. High: events are complete, and card filing plus the review remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Do clerical work and mail material out

steps.what: Perform clerical activities, answering phones and sorting mail
Do filing, photocopying, typing, and word processing
Draft the outgoing material from the stored note
Review the material before it is mailed
Complete the mailing of the approved material

tasks.design: The assistant answers phones, sorts mail, files, photocopies, and types. {DOCS} drafts outgoing material from a stored note with its fields filled. The assistant reviews it, and {EMAIL} sends only that accepted version. A missing address or a missing note stays blank and nothing is mailed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same note was retyped into each outgoing item.
tasks.enabler_now: The note's fields are stored, so the outgoing text can be filled and stopped when an address is blank.
tasks.still_hard: The phone, the photocopy, and the mail sort stay physical.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant will not mail a note that names the wrong person.
tasks.altitude: Clerical handling stays. Outgoing material leaves only in the version the assistant accepted.

reach.task: Supply the note that should be mailed
reach.learn: Which notes are ready to send and which are still a draft.

evidence.claim: A stored note can fill outgoing material, and a missing address stops the send.
Mailed material can name a person. The assistant accepts the text before it is sent. The design does not score callers.

assumptions: The work starts with a call, a piece of mail, or a note, and ends with filing, a photocopy, or a sent item.
A note row has addressee, subject, and body fields, entered by the librarian or the assistant. A blank addressee is not invented.
The mailing uses the version accepted in the review. Phone time and photocopying are not part of the send.
unknowns: Which outgoing notes are allowed to leave the library.
research_questions: How many drafts stopped on a blank address, and how many were mailed?

already_counted.description: Answering phones and sorting mail is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct an addressee on a note the assistant has not yet accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most of the day is phones, filing, and photocopying, and notes are incomplete. High: complete notes are mailed after review, and the phone and photocopy remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Register patrons and issue borrower cards

steps.what: Register new patrons and the identification they show
Assemble the borrower record from the registered fields
Review the borrower record before the card is issued
Record the permit to borrow books and other materials
Issue the borrower identification cards in person

tasks.design: The assistant registers the patron from the identification they show. {DOCS} assembles the borrower record and records the permit to borrow only after the assistant accepts that version. The assistant then hands over the identification card. A missing name or identification number stays blank and no permit is recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant copied the identification onto a card and into a book.
tasks.enabler_now: The same fields can fill the record once, and a blank required field can stop the permit.
tasks.still_hard: Checking the identification, and handing the card to the person, stay at the desk.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant refuses a registration when the identification does not match the person.

ambition.what: A patron with complete identification can be registered while they wait, and an incomplete one is not given a card.

tasks.altitude: The assistant still checks the person. The permit is recorded only after that check.

reach.task: Decide a registration the desk will not complete

evidence.claim: Entered identification fields can fill a borrower record and stop when a required field is blank.
A borrower record is personal data. The assistant accepts it before the permit is recorded. The design does not score patrons.

assumptions: The work starts when a new patron arrives and ends when the card is handed over or the assistant refuses.
The assistant enters name, address, and identification number from the document shown. A blank required field is not invented.
The permit write uses the record accepted in the review. Handing over the card stays with the assistant.
unknowns: Which identification documents the library accepts.
research_questions: How many registrations stopped on a blank field, and how many cards were handed over?

already_counted.description: Handing the borrower identification card to the patron is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a registration field before the assistant has accepted the record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: identification is often incomplete, so the assistant still copies it by hand. High: complete registrations are recorded after review, and the card is still handed over in person. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant still meets patrons, shelves items, and handles cash. A record, notice, invoice, or order is written or sent only after the assistant accepts that version.
reach: A librarian receives the question the assistant could not answer from the desk.
A finance colleague receives only an invoice the assistant has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required field is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep shelving, cash, and patron conversations in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every item on loan has a location and a due date the desk can trust, and the assistant still decides the exception.
